fields.title: Columns
fields.description:
The names of the columns from the input file to be resorted.

You can either select the columns and move their position up or down, using the up and down arrows, or sort them alphabetically from first to last (A-Z) or from last to first (Z-A). You can also reset all to the order of the input table.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица
